name: Ambxst Skwd-wall
description: Hands every wallpaper (images, videos and GIFs) to skwd-wall's renderer and brings its 39 transitions into the notch's Wallpapers tab: a carousel of transition cards with line-art previews, animation duration, automatic rotation with Match Time of Day, shuffle, pause-on-fullscreen and Material You colour settings, all following your Ambxst theme. Ambxst keeps its library, picker, per-screen wallpapers and matugen colours. On a 4K video wallpaper across two monitors it measured about half the video-decoder load, a quarter of the CPU and ~450 MB less VRAM than Ambxst's own player. Replaces Wallpaper Transitions (by POSiTiiiV, MIT), whose settings panel it builds on. Installs skwd-wall for you from its official releases with one button (or uses your system's copy); until then Ambxst draws wallpapers itself as before.
author: drpezzer
permissions: Starts and stops skwd-wall's daemon as a user service (systemctl --user) and tells it which wallpaper each screen shows with skwd-helm

When you press Install or Update: downloads skwd-wall's deck and paper packages from liixini's GitHub releases, checks them against the release's SHA256SUMS, unpacks them into ~/.local/share/ambxst/skwd-wall and writes ~/.config/systemd/user/ambxst-skwd-walld.service. Nothing outside your home, no password
Writes the transition and playback keys of skwd-wall's config, ~/.config/skwd-wall-v2/config.json
Sorts your wallpapers by brightness and warmth for Match Time of Day (python3 + ImageMagick), cached in ~/.cache/ambxst/wallpaper_solar_cache.json
Sends one notification if skwd-wall is not installed yet
Keeps its options in ~/.config/ambxst/skwd-wall.json and its wallpaper settings in Ambxst's state file
